newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan Imiter mine profits down in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan Imiter mine profits down in 1996.

text.p: Morocco's Imiter silver mine said on Thursday its net profits fell to 43 million dirhams in 1996 ($4.39 million) from 52 million dirhams the year before.

It said the 1995 figure was inflated by the sale of production which had been left over from the previous year, and the 1996 figure was affected by the adoption of more standard accounting methods for depreciation and provisions.
Turnover for 1996 totalled 260.9 million dirhams against 311.6 million dirhams in 1995.
In June, the privatisation ministry floated 20 percent of Imiter worth 130.3 million dirhams.

The state had been holding a stake of 33 percent of SMI through the state-run Bureau des Recherches et Participations Minieres (BRPM). The remaining 67 percent of the capital is owned by Morocco's largest private conglomerate ONA.
